text:
jules: Quick request for runtime — marketing needs a minimal acceptance pack for the webinar + launch post. Can someone run a focused smoke/sanity run we can cite?
kai: Sure. What's the exact acceptance criteria for marketing copy? numbers and context help.
jules: For the short demo (256 tokens) we currently draft: median latency ~70ms, p95 < 220ms, p99 < 420ms on H100 with int8. For the long context slide (2048 tokens) we show steady-state p95 and a note about streaming tradeoffs.
marta: We'll need exact repro: model name+checksum, quant flags, qps used, and the payload seed. Also please tell us whether warmup traffic was simulated or not.
jules: Use seed: mkting-seed-2026 (I'll DM). Warmup: three warmup windows then steady state. Include both simulated warmup and coldstart traces.
ivy: Do you want token-level traces or only per-request aggregates? Token traces are heavy.
jules: Per-request aggregates for all runs. Token-level traces for 8 representative requests (pick different length shards) is enough. Also need raw CSVs and a README with the run command.
kai: Noted. What hardware pool? h100-medium or h100-large? warmup concurrency?
jules: Use h100-medium (our default pub demo pool), qps 50 for 256-token runs, qps 10 for 2k streaming. Streaming mode should be its own run.
marta: We'll run fp16 + int8. If int4 is stable we'll toss it in labelled experimental. Also capture cache-hit rate metrics and whether prefix-caching was active.
ops-runner: Queued job 90211 on h100-medium. Expect smoke ~1.5h. Will produce artifact: manifest.txt, per_request.csv, token_traces_sample.csv, README.md, p95_p99_onepager.png.
jules: Timeline? We need the smoke artifacts by Tue 10am PT to update deck. Full sweep (all variants) can follow later.
ops-runner: Smoke artifacts ETA Tue 08:50 PT — will post GCS link here. If we hit any issues with model checksum we'll ping immediately.
ivy: Please include exact run command example for reproducibility. Marketing will paste it into the appendix.
marta: Example we'll include: 
```
MODEL=model-v4-int8 CHECKSUM=sha256:abcd1234 RUN_SEED=mkting-seed-2026 ./bench/run_local.sh --qps 50 --tokens 256 --warmup 3
```
jules: Perfect. Also add a one-line note about variance: "single-run measurements; expect ±5% on p95 due to scheduler noise and cache effects."
ops-runner: upload completed: gs://redwood-marketing/webinar/1765432199/smoke_artifacts.tar.gz (4.1MB)
jules: Downloading now. Will flag any copy changes.
ivy: I'll review the manifest and check the p95/p99 numbers against the draft. If there's a mismatch we'll ask for a brief rerun.
marta: If they want a rerun with adjusted qps/warmup we can do fast-turnaround on a single variant.
jules: Thanks all — this keeps the launch timeline intact. Will update the slide with the PNG once verified.
ops-runner: standing by for followups. runtime-bot: job 90211 finished successfully. Logs: gs://redwood-marketing/webinar/1765432199/logs/90211.log
jules: Great, thanks everyone.
